_about: Bug fixes since the baseline commit and the regression tests that exercise each, checked by
A regression test is a test added or changed in the fix commit, or named in its message.
untested_parts names a part of a fix that no test exercises.

rule.selects: every commit since the baseline whose subject or body (trailers removed) matches message_pattern, case-insensitive, and every commit that adds an entry under a '### Fixed' heading of CHANGELOG.md
rule.definition: A bug fix corrects behaviour of shipped code, scripts, tests or CI that was wrong before the commit, including messages the code prints. Documentation-only corrections, new features, evidence re-freezes and new tests of behaviour that was already right are not bug fixes.
rule.review: Every selected commit is either a fix mapped to regression tests (test node ids that must exist) or an exclusion with a reason. A fix the rule misses is added by hand with selected_by: manual. A fix with no test stays listed, with no_test_reason, and is reported as open.

fixes.bug: resasm verify returned 0 on the shipped unloaded stressed C3D8 with ||R_free|| = 70.71; equilibrium verification now fails unbalanced or non-finite residuals against an explicit absolute tolerance.

The history engine's solve mode started each increment from a jump (the explicit FCC update overflowed) and accepted non-finite states; it now takes Abaqus's linear predictor and refuses non-finite states. The engine itself was added earlier in this work (9dd6a8c).
fixes.untested_parts: No test forces a non-finite state to show it is refused.

fixes.bug: Newton iterated for minutes on round-off when no step lowered the residual, and run_report's 'Command executed' line was rendered from sys.argv, which is wrong when resasm runs in-process.
fixes.untested_parts: No test drives Newton into stagnation to show the 'stagnated at' error.

fixes.bug: The clean-install gate refused every checkout not on one hard-coded branch name, so it could not run on main or on a fresh clone.
fixes.no_test_reason: tests/integration/test_clean_install_gate.py does not exercise --branch or the branch check; only the gate step of the clean-clone run (with --branch main) exercises it, outside the suite.

fixes.bug: CI never installed the companion UMAT-OTI, so the connected tests could not be collected there, and the verification-record scripts refused a umat_oti installed from a wheel (a clean clone's install) because its files are not under the checkout.
fixes.untested_parts: The CI workflow change is exercised only by CI itself.

fixes.bug: Two replay-history modules imported helpers with 'from conftest import', which resolves to whichever conftest was imported last, so renaming a test folder broke them; two imports of residual_core.replay.presentation had been rewritten by a folder rename.
The claim-5 verification script ran plain 'make'; GNU make predefines FC=f77, so the generated Makefile's 'FC ?= gfortran' never applied and the build failed wherever f77 is absent.
The real-store contract tests refused a umat_oti installed (not editable) from the companion checkout because its files were not under the checkout, and skipped with a reason CI rejects.
fixes.untested_parts: These tests run only where the private corpus store is present; in CI and in a clean clone they skip, so no test that runs there exercises the byte-identical-copy rule.

fixes.bug: scripts/extract_odb_fields.py failed at line 1 under Abaqus 2021's Python 2.7 (non-ASCII text without a coding line, annotations, shutil.which).

resasm sensitivity --backend dual1 printed zero derivatives and exited 0 for parameters no element seeds; a failing finite-difference comparison still exited 0; exit 3 and the OTILib hint were given for a missing tangent; missing --fields files gave tracebacks; the GUI's Job tab read the wrong folder.
resasm request kept a valid non-J2 provider on the bounded J2 engine, which refused it as material_mapping (exit 2); run_report.txt listed public files a failed run had not written.
The ODB exporter's error message and usage text told users to run extract_abaqus_fields.py, a file that no longer exists under that name.
fixes.no_test_reason: No test checks the exporter's usage or error text; the commit changed text only.

fixes.bug: The cantilever central-difference reference script recorded its usage line as the reference's note instead of its method paragraph.
fixes.no_test_reason: tests/replay_history/test_cantilever_decks.py checks the decks, not the reference script's output; no test runs fd_reference.py.

fixes.bug: resasm backends printed 'tangent_support: none' for every material, and the UMAT adapter listed strain inputs while declaring a deformation gradient.
The general deck path (inspect, assemble, verify) accepted *Dload, *Dsload, *Equation and amplitudes without a word although it applies none of them.
SolidC3D8SmallStrain handed a finite-strain material a strain increment and failed with a bare KeyError('F0').
When the unrelated PyPI package pyoti shadowed the genuine OTILib build, the probe said only that OTILib was not found.
resasm history --verify fd judged derivatives against max(1e-6, twice the plateau spread), so with an unresolved reference a 9.6e-1 error was reported 'Derivative verified: yes'.

requirements/doctor called modes ready that assembled nothing (assemble exited 0 with ndof=0), C3D8 replay bound silent default constants [200000, 0.3], verify judged equilibrium without the deck's unapplied loads and constraints, and multi-step or NLGEOM decks were summed over steps.
resasm history, and resasm request when it hands a model to the history engine, exited 0 whatever the requested --verify found.

excluded.reason: Evidence (full-size whole-model FD); 'failed' is the suite's failure count.
Feature (ticks, output, region and Solve on the request screen); 'failed' is the suite's failure count.
Feature and its browser test (equivalent plastic strain after Solve); 'failed' is the suite's failure count.
Evidence rerun of the benchmark claim; 'defect' and 'fails' describe a UMAT source defect it measured, and 'fixes' the transformer fixes mapped in UMAT_source_transformation (b124e39, 24143f8).
New independent check (Euler's homogeneity identity); 'wrong' is a hypothetical wrong derivative the check would catch and 'fixed' is 'at fixed nu'.
Pin bump of the companion; 'fixes' names commits of UMAT_source_transformation.
Documentation (seven worked examples and guides); 'stale' describes the GUI's documented guard against stale results.
Documentation; 'stale' describes a documentation note it removed.
New tests (report verdict lines, walkthroughs, derivative-loss scan) of behaviour that was already right; no code change.
Documentation (walkthrough for example 8) and its index test; 'exits 2' describes measured behaviour.
Evidence re-freeze and pin bump; 'fix' names the local-Jacobian fix of UMAT_source_transformation (1996782), mapped there.
Tooling (completion-ledger mapping and its update script); 'refuses' describes the script rejecting an incomplete run directory, not a corrected behaviour.
Tooling (the integrity audits themselves); 'exit 2' and 'stale' describe what the audit reports, not a corrected behaviour.
